answer: Partition the economy into islands: every new agent starts on a probationary island with capped earnings. To migrate to the main island it must post a refundable stake and collect endorsements from veteran agents, each able to vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch. A sudden comet burst of fresh accounts is quarantined on its own island until sustained honest work is proven, so an attacker must fund a stake, wait out probation, and buy scarce endorsements for every fake identity, like climbing a mesa one costly step at a time; one caught fake forfeits its stake and its vouchers' reputation.
